description: Form 6251 line 2f applies even when the regular NOL deduction is zero. Single 2026: wages $10,000, ISO spread $500,000, post-2017 NOL $300,000 (regular taxable income is zero, so no regular deduction), ATNOLD $300,000. Line 1b 10,000 − 16,100 = −6,100; + line 2a 16,100 + line 2i 500,000 = $510,000; line 2f min(300,000, 90% × 510,000) = −$300,000 → AMTI $210,000.
